label: Gastroenterology
description: Gastrointestinal and hepatic conditions, including inflammatory bowel disease, hereditary GI cancer syndromes, and liver disease, with a focus on genetic variants and endoscopic/serologic findings.

fewShotExamples.input: 34-year-old man with Crohn's disease, ileal involvement, NOD2 variant positive, steroid-dependent...
50-year-old woman with Lynch syndrome, MLH1 mutation, newly diagnosed colorectal cancer...
45-year-old man with cirrhosis secondary to NASH, MELD score 18, evaluated for transplant...

eventExtraction.categoryIntro: Extract all clinically relevant and actionable events in the following categories:

categories.name: Genetic variants
categories.block:
**Category 1 — Genetic variants (ALWAYS include the variant type):**
Do NOT output a bare gene name. ALWAYS append the variant type.
Examples: "NOD2 variant", "MLH1 mutation", "MSH2 mutation", "PNPLA3 variant"

categories.name: Endoscopic / histologic findings
categories.block:
**Category 2 — Endoscopic / histologic findings:**
"ileal ulceration", "villous atrophy", "Barrett's esophagus"

categories.name: Lab / serologic markers
categories.block:
**Category 3 — Lab / serologic markers:**
"elevated fecal calprotectin", "positive anti-TTG antibody", "elevated ALT"

categories.name: Microbiome / infectious findings
categories.block:
**Category 4 — Microbiome / infectious findings:**
"H. pylori positive", "C. difficile positive"

postCategoryNotes: Focus on information that is directly relevant to potential therapy selection or clinical management. Avoid vague or redundant information like "tolerating oral diet".

CRITICAL: For genetic events, NEVER emit just a gene name (e.g., "NOD2"). ALWAYS include the variant type (e.g., "NOD2 variant"). A bare gene name is not an actionable event — the variant type determines whether it is clinically significant.

fewShotExample.caseNoteInput: 34-year-old man with a 5-year history of steroid-dependent Crohn's disease, ileal involvement. Colonoscopy shows ileal ulceration. Fecal calprotectin is markedly elevated. Genetic testing reveals a NOD2 variant. Currently being evaluated for biologic therapy.

guidanceNotes: **Focus on Actionable Events:** We are not trying to summarize the case but to find what information is relevant to decision-making. This helps filter noise and focus on clinically significant findings.
**Prioritization:** Prioritizing genotype- and biomarker-driven studies ensures searches are matched to the patient's specific GI condition.
**Specific Search Terms:** Using exact terms such as "NOD2 variant" is essential for precision. Adding "therapy", "treatment" or "clinical trials" helps to find relevant studies.
**Combinations:** Combining genetic and endoscopic/serologic features allows for refined searches that might be more relevant to the patient.
**Iteration:** If initial search results are not helpful, we can modify and refine the queries based on the available data.

articleScoring.evaluationGoal: evaluate full research articles related to gastroenterology and hepatology, especially those concerning genetic or inflammatory GI conditions, to identify potential advancements in treatment and understanding of the disease

domainFilterField.label: GI Focus
domainFilterField.description: Whether the article relates to a gastrointestinal or hepatic condition

fields.label: Disease Match
fields.description: Set to true if the article's disease focus matches the patient's disease. Articles that cover the exact condition in question receive significant points.

fields.label: Drugs Tested
fields.description: Whether any drugs are mentioned as tested

fields.label: Treatment Results
fields.description: Set to true if the article demonstrates positive treatment results

fields.label: Cell Studies
fields.description: Whether drugs were tested on cells in vitro

fields.label: Animal Model Studies
fields.description: Whether drugs were tested in animal models

fields.label: Case Report
fields.description: Whether the article presents a case report

fields.label: Series of Case Reports
fields.description: Whether the article presents multiple case reports

fields.label: Clinical Study
fields.description: Whether the article describes a clinical study

fields.label: Novelty
fields.description: If the paper describes a novel mechanism or therapeutic strategy
